resolution.note: pytest canary runs unskipped; CI setup-ci installs pinned pytest; no vitest skip remains

title: Canary vitest and pytest fixtures run where CI lacks the runners
body:
Outcome: the canary vitest and pytest fixtures run in CI instead of skipping where the runner is absent.
Why: they skip without pytest or a vitest install to link.
Proof: both canary tests run, none skipped.
